verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a first-party Zapier integration ('connect your mail to 5000+ apps') and an API, which plausibly provides event-driven triggers for downstream automation. However, no specific new-mail or scan-complete trigger is named, and no registrable webhooks are documented; real-time email alerts are an adjacent feature and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented webhook endpoints/registration, explicitly named Zapier triggers for new mail and scan completion, API reference docs (OpenAPI probes 404), independent corroboration.
